Search visibility: 30 queries re-checked against live SERPs on 2026-06-19. NOTABLE COMPETITIVE MOVE: 'osteopath addington' SERP has tightened — Performance Plus Physio Christchurch's /osteopath-addington-christchurch/ URL is now #1 (the last 4 runs were UK-only hollow: sanderstead-osteopaths.co.uk, fresha.com etc.). A new NZ-side competitor has executed the same suburb-specific dedicated-URL pattern we keep observing in other queries (Halswell Clinic for /osteopath-halswell-vs-physio/, House of Acupuncture for /our-services/acc-acupuncture-chistchurch, Better Health for /resources/osteopath-vs-chiropractor/). Performance Plus Physio also now surfaces at #2 in the 'sports injury osteopath christchurch' SERP. Item #29 (Wigram/Addington/etc. in flowing intro copy) shipped 40+ days ago — no movement, and now a rival has claimed the Addington slot. AI-SUMMARY ENTITY SHIFT: 'paediatric osteopath christchurch' AI summary no longer names Nina Hu — last run it gave her email + phone explicitly; this run names Alix Ramousse (Better Health's paediatric specialist) instead. Expected per Ahrefs 2026-05 study (54.5% URL overlap between consecutive AIO responses). 'osteopath vs physiotherapist christchurch' SERP shake-up continues: Halswell's osteopath-vs-physio-vs-chiro post (the long-standing #1 non-aggregator) is no longer in visible top 10; replaced by Australian dedicated-comparison URLs (13thbeachhealthservices.com.au, alignhc.com.au). 'lower back pain christchurch' shifted from osteo-dominant to mixed osteo+physio+chiro+sports-clinic. Five first-time checks for queries added last run — 'acupuncture for endometriosis christchurch' (Burwood blog leads, House of Acupuncture has dedicated /acupuncture-endometriosis-period-pelvic-pain), 'acupuncture for pcos christchurch' (House of Acupuncture dominates with 4 URLs, Vitalis Auckland #2), 'acupuncture for cancer christchurch' (Koru Healing #1; field is fragmented — no entrenched NZ winner, Min Jin's PR #98 content faces tractable competition here), 'headaches osteopath christchurch' (Better Health #1, same blog-velocity pattern), 'post concussion syndrome christchurch' (completely different set than 'post concussion osteopath' — medical/specialist clinics: headachetendon.nz Concussion Clinic CFR, migraineclinic.co.nz, Axis Sports Medicine). Two queries pruned (below priority 20 for 3+ runs and no realistic ranking path): 'acupuncture vs dry needling' (US authority sites win, PR #78 FAQ entry still not picked up at 33 days) and 'headaches migraines osteopath christchurch' (replaced by cleaner 'headaches osteopath christchurch' added last run). Two new derived queries added: 'acupuncture for period pain christchurch' (tests Min Jin's dysmenorrhoea focus) and 'sciatica christchurch' (broader non-osteo variant — tests whether our /conditions/sciatica/ page can surface on the shorter higher-volume query). Standard -10 decay applied across all 30 queries below top 10. Pool size 45/50.

Industry signals (week of 2026-06-12 → 2026-06-19): (1) **Google Search Console Gen AI performance report rollout is regional** — reports + opt-out toggle started rolling out to a subset of UK website owners first ahead of global release; not yet available globally. Reinforces #35 — the verification work (does meridianosteopathy.co.nz have admin access, is the opt-in toggle ON when our region gets coverage) still needs doing before rollout reaches NZ, but the report shows impressions only (no clicks, no CTR, no traffic). (2) Reddit citation share data has hardened — Reddit now accounts for 21% of all Google AI Overview citations (single most cited domain on AIO), 46.5% on Perplexity (stable), and is #2 on ChatGPT behind only Wikipedia. Reddit has 23.6M pages cited in AI responses, appearing in 92.8% of all AI search opportunities. Reinforces #15. (3) Healthcare AEO/GEO benchmark data (Conductor + Contently June 2026): AI search visits grew 42.8% YoY (Q1 2025 → Q1 2026 from 15.6B → 27.4B). Mayo Clinic dominates with 14.1% AI visibility score and 3.4% share of voice across AI platforms; Cleveland Clinic + Johns Hopkins follow. The single most-overlooked GEO lever for healthcare is co-citation — appearing alongside trusted medical entities across multiple independent sources, not schema markup. Reinforces #14 (blog with named-clinician + datePublished) and #15 (off-site community presence builds co-citation). (4) Schema-validation outlook (DigitalApplied + Stackmatix June 2026): Google's internal documentation from March 2026 still confirms structured data quality as ONE input alongside PageRank + freshness + relevance — not a dominant lever. Late-2026 outlook is that AI systems will cross-reference schema claims against live sources and penalize inaccurate schema rather than ignore it. Reinforces last week's Ahrefs schema-impact finding — do not keep stacking schema for its own sake; keep what we have accurate. (5) Anthropic side-note: Claude web search policy change — organisations using Claude via API will need to actively allow web search by end of June 2026 (default-deny from July 2026). Not actionable on our site (it concerns Anthropic API admin, not website owners), but it's worth knowing that ClaudeBot crawl and Claude.ai-citation traffic are increasingly governed by org-level access rules. Tier 1 → #35 (enable GSC Gen AI report when NZ region gets coverage). Tier 2 → #12, #13, #25, #32. Tier 3 → #14, #15, #16.

gaps.title: No blog / editorial content
gaps.why: Freshness cliff at ~3 months. April-2026 industry data: 76.4% of ChatGPT's top-cited pages were updated within 30 days, 50% of Perplexity citations come from content less than 13 weeks old. osteopath-christchurch.com is winning headache/migraine/cranial/baby-osteo queries on blog-post velocity — 1 short post per condition is enough to claim those niches. MK Osteopathy is doing the same for TMJ. May-2026 BrightEdge / Healthcare Success data confirms the pattern is hardening: AI Overviews now trigger on 88% of healthcare queries (up from 72% in 2024), with cited brands earning 35% more clicks and AI visitors converting 4.4× higher than organic. Reinforced 2026-06-05 by Ahrefs schema study (1,885 pages adding JSON-LD vs 4,000 controls, Aug 2025–Mar 2026): adding schema produced NO major uplift in AI citations on any platform — entity authority + content depth/freshness do the work, not schema markup. Local SEO data this week: content updated within the past two months earns 28% more AI citations than older material. The case for blog freshness is now the strongest it has been since the audit started.

gaps.why: Reddit appears in 46.5% of Perplexity citations (stable as of week of 2026-06-12) and is the #2 most-cited domain on ChatGPT behind only Wikipedia. CONFIRMED 2026-06-19: Reddit now accounts for 21% of all Google AI Overview citations — the single most-cited domain on AIO. Reddit has 23.6M pages cited in AI responses, appearing in 92.8% of all AI search opportunities (ZipTie + Frase June 2026). Healthcare AEO/GEO benchmark data (Conductor + Contently June 2026): co-citation — appearing alongside trusted medical entities across multiple independent sources — is the single most-overlooked GEO lever for healthcare brands, more so than schema markup. Reddit is the second most visible website in Google search results in 2026 (only Wikipedia ahead). Tinuiti Q1 2026 data: social-media share of AI citations climbed past 9% Oct-2025 → Jan-2026, with Reddit accounting for the dominant share of that growth across nine product categories. ClaudeBot crawl volume grew 800% at the start of 2026; Anthropic's June 2026 policy change (default-deny web search for API orgs from July 2026) puts more weight on organic Reddit citations as the path into Claude's answers. Item #15 still applies.

items.title: Add speakable blocks on service intros
items.body: Add schema.org speakable specification on service intro paragraphs for voice assistants / Gemini Live. With the citation-ready 40–60 word answers now in place (item #31 shipped 2026-05-17), wrapping them in a speakable block is the natural follow-up — gives voice assistants a single span to read aloud rather than guessing. NOTE 2026-06-05: Ahrefs schema-study (week-of-2026-05) found adding JSON-LD produced no major uplift in AI citations — so this is a low-impact-but-still-cheap item; do not over-prioritise.

items.title: Auto-fetch Google Business Profile reviews at build time
items.body: So reviewCount / ratingValue stay current without manual edits. Build script hits Places API with a 24h cache. Reinforced this week (2026-06-05): local-SEO data shows reviews older than 18 months 'carry diminishing weight' for AI citation confidence; content and signals updated within the past two months earn 28% more AI citations than older material. GBP is the primary data source for AI-driven local search per May-2026 PinMeTo / MedRankSEO data. May-2026 mapranks / icreatebrand confirm: Google is replacing Maps Q&A with Gemini-generated answers pulled from GBP + reviews + the clinic website, so review freshness now directly feeds the Maps-surface answer generation as well.

items.title: Start a blog (2 posts/month)
items.body: Short evidence-based articles per condition. Each post: author byline with Physician schema, datePublished, dateModified, 3–5 FAQs. Ahrefs analysis of 17M AI citations (April 2026) found AI-cited content is 25.7% fresher than traditional Google organic results — 76.4% of ChatGPT's top-cited pages were updated within the last 30 days. Freshness compounds. Confirmed again 2026-06-19: osteopath-christchurch.com still owns headaches/cranial/baby/teeth-grinding/stress/arthritis queries on the strength of one short blog post per condition; MK Osteopathy still owns the TMJ slot the same way; and on the new 'osteopath addington' SERP, Performance Plus Physio's dedicated /osteopath-addington-christchurch/ URL just claimed #1 from the UK-only hollow set — the suburb-specific dedicated-URL pattern works for NZ-side competitors who execute it. STRONGEST CASE YET FOR THIS ITEM 2026-06-05/19: (a) Ahrefs schema-impact study (1,885 pages adding JSON-LD vs 4,000 controls) found NO major uplift in AI citations on AIO, AI Mode, or ChatGPT — removes schema as a competing investment lever; content depth + freshness are doing the work. (b) Healthcare AEO/GEO benchmark data (Conductor + Contently June 2026): Mayo Clinic dominates AI healthcare citations with 14.1% visibility score and 3.4% share of voice — they get there with named-clinician review, current medical sources, structured answer formats, visible review dates and co-citation, NOT schema. (c) Per local-SEO week-of-2026-05 data, pages updated within the past two months earn 28% more AI citations than older material. With /admin CMS coverage now filled (PR #91), the editorial path is shorter than it was — adding a Decap blog collection would let the clinic publish without code changes.

items.title: Seed Reddit / community brand mentions
items.body: Genuine, non-spammy answers on r/newzealand / r/chch / r/AskNZ threads about osteopathy, ACC claims, back pain. CONFIRMED 2026-06-19: Reddit now accounts for 21% of all Google AI Overview citations (single most cited domain on AIO), 46.5% of Perplexity citations (stable week of 2026-06-12), and is #2 on ChatGPT behind only Wikipedia. Reddit has 23.6M pages cited in AI responses, appearing in 92.8% of all AI search opportunities. Healthcare AEO/GEO benchmark data (Conductor + Contently June 2026): co-citation — appearing alongside trusted medical entities across multiple independent sources — is the single most-overlooked GEO lever for healthcare; more important than schema markup. Tinuiti Q1 2026 data: social-media share of AI citations climbed past 9% Oct-2025 → Jan-2026 with Reddit accounting for the dominant share of that growth. Conductor research note: when LLMs do cite Reddit, sole-source citations rose 31% — Reddit is increasingly the only source for a given answer. ClaudeBot scaled 800% at start of 2026; Anthropic's June-2026 default-deny web-search policy for API orgs (effective July 2026) shifts weight onto organic Reddit + Wikipedia citations as the dominant path into Claude's answers. 90/10 rule: 90% non-promotional, 2–4 weeks of karma-building before any mention of Meridian.

items.title: Encourage monthly Google reviews nudge

Reinforced 2026-05-02: Google's March 2026 core update now weights review recency AND owner response rate more heavily than raw count. Healthcare best-practice = at least 1 new review/week. May-2026 PinMeTo data: GBP is the primary data source for AI-driven local search across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity location queries. Reinforced 2026-06-05: local-SEO data this week confirms 'reviews older than 18 months carry diminishing weight' for AI citation confidence, and content/signals updated within the past two months earn 28% more AI citations than older material. Combined with #13 (auto-fetch reviews at build time), this closes the GBP review-recency loop end to end.

Page exists pattern to copy; effort S.

items.title: Enable Google Search Console Generative AI performance report before opt-out toggle goes live
items.body: Google launched a dedicated Generative AI performance report in Search Console on 2026-06-03 that tracks impressions for AI Overviews and AI Mode, broken down by pages, countries, devices and dates at hourly through monthly granularity. UPDATE 2026-06-19: rollout is regional — reports + opt-out toggle started rolling out to a subset of UK website owners first ahead of a global release; NZ-region availability is not yet confirmed. The report shows impressions, pages, countries, devices and dates only — no clicks, no CTR, no traffic. This is still the first first-party way to measure AI-search visibility for meridianosteopathy.co.nz (citation overlap with the organic top-10 collapsed to 17–38% post-Gemini-3, so traditional rank tracking misses the majority of the AI-surface story). Action items: (1) verify the clinic's GSC account has meridianosteopathy.co.nz as a verified property, (2) check the GSC interface periodically and turn the AI Overviews / AI Mode toggle ON the moment the report becomes available in NZ (it defaults to ON for newly enabled regions), (3) screenshot the first two weeks of baseline data once available to bank a 'pre-blog' reading before item #14 ships. No code changes needed. Reinforced by Search Engine Journal week-of-2026-05: Google's new AI search guide officially treats AEO and GEO as part of SEO, so the GSC report is intended to be the canonical measurement surface.
